project_type: React 18 + TypeScript + Vite 5 PWA — single SPA deployed on Firebase Hosting
build_system: Vite 5 — `npm run build` produces dist/. vite-plugin-pwa (v0.21+, requires Vite 5) generates service worker via Workbox. tailwindcss v3 via postcss. No monorepo.
test_framework: No test framework initially — vitest can be added later. Verification is `npm run build` (must exit 0 with no TS errors).
verification_instructions: 1. Run `npm install` in workspace root. 2. Copy .env.example to .env and fill Firebase credentials (or leave placeholder values — the build still compiles). 3. Run `npm run build`. Expect no TypeScript errors, dist/ created with sw.js and manifest.webmanifest. 4. Run `npm run preview` to smoke-test locally.
snapshot_or_generated_files: dist/ — produced by `npm run build`, not committed. public/manifest.json is committed. src/i18n/fr.json and en.json are committed translation files.
environment_constraints: Windows workspace (PowerShell). No Firebase emulator required at build time — Firebase config reads from VITE_ env vars. Do NOT run `firebase deploy` — that requires user credentials. All paths use forward slashes in source files; Windows absolute paths only in this context.json.
contribution_requirements: Greenfield project — no existing AGENTS.md or CONTRIBUTING.md. Each FEAT must leave `npm run build` passing. TypeScript strict mode — no `any` without explicit comment. All user-visible strings must exist in both fr.json and en.json.
key_patterns: Greenfield — patterns are defined here. Firebase modular SDK v9+ tree-shakeable imports (`import { getFirestore } from 'firebase/firestore'`). Zustand stores use typed `create<StateType>()` with `immer` middleware only where needed. Firestore real-time via `onSnapshot` only — no FCM. Routes protected via `<ProtectedRoute role={...}>` wrapper component. i18n via `useTranslation()` hook from react-i18next. Tailwind classes — mobile-first. Framer Motion for animations (countdown, card transitions). sessionId stored in sessionStorage to identify individual clients at a shared table.
directory_structure: Root: config files (package.json, vite.config.ts, tsconfig.json, tailwind.config.js, postcss.config.js, firebase.json, firestore.rules, firestore.indexes.json, .env.example). public/: manifest.json, icons (pwa icons referenced in manifest). src/: main.tsx, App.tsx. src/lib/: firebase.ts (init), firestore.ts (CRUD helpers). src/types/: index.ts (all shared TS types). src/i18n/: index.ts, fr.json, en.json. src/store/: cartStore.ts, authStore.ts, orderStore.ts. src/hooks/: useOrders.ts, useProducts.ts, useRealtime.ts. src/components/ui/: Button.tsx, Badge.tsx, Modal.tsx, Card.tsx, Spinner.tsx, LanguageSwitcher.tsx. src/components/client/: MenuCard.tsx, CartDrawer.tsx, OrderStatus.tsx, CountdownTimer.tsx. src/components/serveur/: TableCard.tsx, OrderCard.tsx, OrderActions.tsx. src/components/cuisine/: TicketCard.tsx, KanbanBoard.tsx, TimerSelector.tsx. src/components/admin/: StatsCard.tsx, ProductForm.tsx, TableForm.tsx, UserForm.tsx, QRCodeDisplay.tsx. src/pages/: LoginPage.tsx. src/pages/client/: TablePage.tsx, OrderTracking.tsx. src/pages/serveur/: ServeurDashboard.tsx. src/pages/cuisine/: CuisineDashboard.tsx. src/pages/admin/: AdminDashboard.tsx, MenuManagement.tsx, TableManagement.tsx, UserManagement.tsx, OrderHistory.tsx, Reports.tsx. src/seed/: seedData.ts.
